wiki/audits/content-audit-homepage.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Compare the homepage’s stated services, service area, contact details, and next action with owner-confirmed facts. Record contradictions and missing proof before drafting repairs.

## Use this note

Inputs: The current homepage, its intended customer task, and owner-confirmed services, service area, and contact details.

Result: Passage-level findings with factual contradictions, missing proof, and a proposed repair for owner review.

wiki/audits/content-audit-overview.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Inventory existing pages and their intended user tasks. Identify duplication, unsupported claims, and gaps against supplied business evidence.

## Use this note

Inputs: A dated page inventory, page purposes, business priorities, and the evidence available for each page.

Result: An audit map identifying overlap, unsupported claims, evidence gaps, and the appropriate page-level review.

wiki/audits/content-audit-supporting-pag.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Check whether each supporting page answers a distinct customer question and links to the relevant service. Remove conclusions that the supplied source does not support.

## Use this note

Inputs: The supporting-page inventory, customer questions, page drafts, and the relevant service pages.

Result: A page/question/service map with gaps, duplication, and specific consolidation or revision proposals.

wiki/audits/content-planning-geographica.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use the confirmed service area and observed customer questions to propose location-page candidates. Treat unverified place names and demand as needs_input.

## Use this note

Inputs: The confirmed service area, actual customer questions, and existing location-page inventory.

Result: Location-page candidates with the distinct customer task, available local evidence, and unresolved facts.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

## Working guidance

Review each proposed location page for distinct business evidence and user value. Consolidate candidates that merely repeat the same service text with a changed place name.

## Use this note

Inputs: Candidate location pages and the business records supporting their claimed local differences.

Result: Keep, consolidate, or needs_input decisions for each candidate, with the supporting evidence.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/audits/content-planning-topical-rel.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Group supplied search queries and customer questions by the task they express. Draft page purposes without inventing search volume or conversion potential.

## Use this note

Inputs: Observed queries and customer questions, with their source, locale, date, and relevant business offering.

Result: Task-based topic groups and proposed page purposes, keeping unmeasured demand and competition unknown.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

## Working guidance

Map topic groups to existing pages. Add a page only when a distinct useful answer and supporting facts exist.

## Use this note

Inputs: The topic groups, existing URL inventory, and evidence supporting each proposed answer.

Result: An existing-page/new-page map, duplication decisions, evidence gaps, and useful internal navigation.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/audits/e-e-a-t-with-about-us-page.m.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Check the About page against supplied identity, qualifications, contact information, and experience records. Request evidence for claims instead of inventing a biography or treating author markup as a ranking lever.

## Use this note

Inputs: The About page and verified identity, qualifications, experience, and contact records.

Result: Supported revisions and proof requests, with unsupported credentials or experience claims flagged.

## Evidence and limits

Google describes E-E-A-T as a quality-assessment concept, not a specific ranking factor. Accurate authorship, sourcing, and demonstrated experience can help readers assess trust. (Claim: eeat-trust-context; sources: google-helpful-content.)

wiki/audits/property-audit-part-1.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Confirm business identity, location model, account ownership, and website inventory using authorized records before evaluating recommendations.

## Use this note

Inputs: Owner-authorized identity and ownership records, the location model, and the website inventory.

Result: A confirmed scope and access record, contradictions to resolve, and the evidence needed before the audit proceeds.

wiki/audits/property-audit-part-2.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review supplied crawl, index, content, link, and measurement evidence. Separate observed problems from possible causes and unmeasured effects.

## Use this note

Inputs: Dated crawl, index, page, link, and measurement exports for the agreed property scope.

Result: Observed issues with exact source locators, separate hypotheses, and the next check needed to test each hypothesis.

wiki/audits/property-audit-quick-wins.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Select reversible repairs supported by observed errors and owner constraints. Describe the practical benefit and missing evidence without invented priority scores.

## Use this note

Inputs: Verified issues, owner priorities, available access, implementation constraints, and rollback options.

Result: A short repair queue justified by the observed problem and practical benefit, with owner and rollback recorded.

wiki/audits/property-content-with-existi.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use supplied page performance and backlink exports to identify content worth reviewing. Do not turn historical traffic or links into a prediction of future ranking.

## Use this note

Inputs: Page performance and backlink exports with matching URLs, dates, and scope.

Result: Pages to review, the measured reason for selection, and a content check rather than a forecast of ranking gains.

wiki/audits/property-ctr-audit.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Compare impressions and clicks within the supplied report’s query, page, device, country, and date scope. Check title relevance; treat changes as observations rather than proof of a ranking mechanism.

## Use this note

Inputs: The click/impression export, its filters and date window, and the current page titles and descriptions.

Result: Comparable click and impression observations, snippet-relevance findings, and explicit limits on causal interpretation.

## Evidence and limits

Aggregated interaction data has been described in primary trial evidence, but this does not validate GA bounce-rate formulas, dwell-time thresholds, CTR manipulation, or local-ranking guarantees. (Claim: behavior-formulas-unsupported; contrary evidence: doj-google-interaction-testimony.)

wiki/audits/property-technical-audit.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review supplied crawl and performance evidence for inaccessible pages, indexing controls, conflicting canonicals, and user-experience problems. State which checks were actually performed.

## Use this note

Inputs: Crawl, indexing-control, canonical, rendering, and performance evidence for the named URLs.

Result: A reproducible finding list identifying the tested control, observation, affected URL, and proposed verification or repair.

## Evidence and limits

Core Web Vitals are used within page-experience systems, but passing them does not guarantee ranking and relevance can outweigh page experience. (Claim: core-web-vitals-scoped; sources: google-page-experience, google-core-web-vitals.)

wiki/backlinks/backlinking-anchors.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Inspect the supplied link sample for readable, relevant anchor text and paid or manipulative placements. Do not prescribe an exact-match ratio.

## Use this note

Inputs: A dated backlink sample with source pages, target URLs, anchor text, placement context, and any paid relationship.

Result: Anchor-context findings, qualification concerns, and evidence gaps, without a prescribed anchor ratio.

## Evidence and limits

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/backlinks/backlinking-competitive-r.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use an authorized competitor link export to identify real organizations and editorial relationships. Verify relevance and legitimacy before recommending owner-approved outreach.

## Use this note

Inputs: An authorized competitor link export, the source pages, and evidence about the organizations involved.

Result: Verified relevant relationships for owner review, with legitimacy checks and no promised ranking outcome.

## Evidence and limits

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/backlinks/backlinking-local-citatio.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Compare supplied listings with owner-confirmed business information. Record directory, URL, observed status, and uncertainty; the adapter does not calculate NAP accuracy.

## Use this note

Inputs: Listing exports or observed listing URLs, collection dates, and owner-confirmed business details.

Result: A directory/URL/status record plus separately verified discrepancies and unknowns; exported status alone does not prove accuracy.

wiki/backlinks/backlinking-no-follow-lin.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Distinguish editorial, paid, and user-added links. Use appropriate qualification rather than promising a ranking benefit from an attribute.

## Use this note

Inputs: The actual linking HTML, page context, destination, and paid or user-generated relationship.

Result: A link-qualification review identifying observed attributes, their context, and the proposed correction if needed.

## Evidence and limits

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/backlinks/backlinking-overview.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review real editorial and business relationships in the supplied evidence. Reject link networks or placements created mainly to manipulate Search.

## Use this note

Inputs: The supplied backlink evidence, real business relationships, and the reason each placement exists.

Result: A scoped review of useful references, manipulation concerns, and verification needed before any outreach proposal.

## Evidence and limits

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/backlinks/social-signals.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use supplied referral reports and actual community questions to understand audience needs. A Google ranking mechanism is outside this review; collect separate evidence before making a causal claim.

## Use this note

Inputs: Dated referral reports, attributable community questions, and the disclosed business participation being reviewed.

Result: Audience questions and referral observations, separated from untested claims about Google ranking effects.

wiki/concepts/ai-overview-in-search.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Check ordinary Search eligibility and supplied AI-feature impression reports. Report the measured scope, missing data, and observational limits.

## Use this note

Inputs: The named AI Search surface, query or report, locale, device, collection date, and website eligibility evidence.

Result: A scoped eligibility or observation record, report limitations, and missing data without a universal click-loss estimate.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no additional technical requirements, mandatory special schema, or AI text file for eligibility in AI Overviews or AI Mode beyond ordinary Search requirements and policies. (Claim: ai-features-no-special-requirements; sources: google-ai-features, google-succeeding-ai-search.)

Two independent observational datasets associate AI-summary result pages with fewer clicks to external/traditional results; no single percentage should be generalized across query sets. (Claim: ai-summary-click-direction; sources: pew-ai-summary-click-study, ahrefs-ai-overview-ctr-study.)

Fixed AI citation counts, Reddit citation-share percentages, and guaranteed local AIO tactics are unsupported across platforms, query classes, locales, and dates. (Claim: ai-citation-formulas-unsupported; contrary evidence: google-ai-features, geo-citation-absorption-2026.)

Google documents worldwide availability of Search Console Generative AI performance reporting as of 2026-08-31. It exposes impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode by page, country, date, and device; dedicated AI-feature click or query reporting is not established by the reviewed documentation. (Claim: search-console-genai-reporting; sources: google-gen-ai-report-launch, google-gen-ai-performance-help.)

wiki/concepts/creating-an-audience-avata.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Summarize needs found in supplied interviews, customer questions, and analytics. Label proposed segments as hypotheses; do not invent demographics or customer testimony.

## Use this note

Inputs: Authorized interviews, actual customer questions, and relevant analytics with collection dates and privacy limits.

Result: Evidence-linked needs and proposed audience segments, distinguishing observed characteristics from hypotheses.

wiki/concepts/how-seo-authority-is-passe.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use crawlable, descriptive links where they help readers. Do not calculate authority points or placement weights from an undocumented model.

## Use this note

Inputs: The source and destination pages, crawlable link markup, anchor context, and the customer navigation task.

Result: A useful-link assessment with observed crawlability and context, leaving undocumented authority arithmetic unsupported.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents evolved PageRank and link-analysis systems as only part of its ranking systems; fixed authority-point arithmetic and placement weights are unsupported. (Claim: page-rank-no-fixed-model; contrary evidence: google-search-ranking-systems, google-seo-starter-guide.)

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/concepts/key-google-rank-factors.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use Google’s public local-result framing to organize evidence. Do not assign private weights or attribute a site movement to an untested mechanism.

## Use this note

Inputs: The local-search surface, business location model, dated observations, and controlling ranking documentation.

Result: An evidence map under relevance, distance, and prominence, without weights or an invented cause for movement.

## Evidence and limits

Google publicly frames local results using relevance, distance, and prominence/popularity; these are not an exhaustive public formula. (Claim: local-ranking-factors; sources: google-local-ranking.)

Google does not publish universal weights, thresholds, or guaranteed lifts for local ranking factors. (Claim: local-ranking-no-public-weights; sources: google-local-ranking.)

Aggregated interaction data has been described in primary trial evidence, but this does not validate GA bounce-rate formulas, dwell-time thresholds, CTR manipulation, or local-ranking guarantees. (Claim: behavior-formulas-unsupported; contrary evidence: doj-google-interaction-testimony.)

wiki/concepts/keyword-research.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Separate observed queries from brainstorming. Record query, source, locale, date, and intended task; volume, competition, or SERP observations remain needs_input when not supplied.

## Use this note

Inputs: Observed queries, customer questions, locale, dates, and business relevance; supply volume or SERP exports only if measured.

Result: A query/source/intent inventory separating observations from brainstormed candidates and marking absent metrics needs_input.

wiki/concepts/what-is-e-e-a-t.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review whether readers can assess identity, experience, expertise, and trust from supported page facts. Do not reduce these considerations to a fabricated score.

## Use this note

Inputs: The named page and evidence supporting its authorship, experience, expertise, sourcing, and business identity.

Result: Trust-related factual gaps and supported improvements, without a numeric E-E-A-T score or ranking guarantee.

## Evidence and limits

Google describes E-E-A-T as a quality-assessment concept, not a specific ranking factor. Accurate authorship, sourcing, and demonstrated experience can help readers assess trust. (Claim: eeat-trust-context; sources: google-helpful-content.)

wiki/concepts/what-is-local-seo.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use local search evidence to help customers find and evaluate a real business. Keep website, Business Profile, Maps, and AI Search requirements scoped to their own surfaces.

## Use this note

Inputs: The real business, customer task, location model, and the Search, Maps, GBP, or AI surface in question.

Result: A surface-specific explanation and evidence checklist, with missing business or platform details identified.

wiki/concepts/which-ai-tools-to-use.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Compare tools on the actual authorized task and privacy boundary. Verify capabilities and availability in current provider documentation before selecting a tool.

## Use this note

Inputs: The authorized task, data sensitivity, required capabilities, and dated provider documentation for the candidate tools.

Result: A capability/privacy comparison and an unresolved-input list; verify access and terms before recommending use.

## Evidence and limits

Derived review notes omit review-author identity; authorized raw exports remain immutable and access-controlled rather than being copied into public deliverables. (Claim: product-review-privacy; sources: local-seo-brain-product-contract.)

wiki/content/content-blog-post-outline.m.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Build an outline from an audience question, supplied sources, and the page’s useful next step. Flag evidence gaps before drafting.

## Use this note

Inputs: The audience question, supplied sources, intended page purpose, and useful next customer step.

Result: A sourced outline identifying the evidence needed for each section and gaps to resolve before writing.

wiki/content/content-blog-post-writing.m.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Draft from the approved outline and supplied sources. Fact-check claims, metadata, and image descriptions; remove invented experience or filler.

## Use this note

Inputs: The approved outline, source passages, owner-confirmed business facts, and authorized media.

Result: A Draft article with attributable claims, checked metadata and image descriptions, and a fact-review list.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

Prompts and workflows must not fabricate firsthand experiences, identities, costs, awards, guarantees, reviews, or community posts. (Claim: truthful-firsthand-content; sources: google-maps-prohibited-content, local-seo-brain-product-contract.)

Google permits generative AI as a content-production aid. Generating many pages without user value may violate scaled-content-abuse policy; content and metadata should be manually checked for accuracy and trustworthiness, with creation context when useful to readers. (Claim: generative-ai-content-quality; sources: google-generative-ai-content-guidance, google-helpful-content.)

wiki/content/content-hidden-content.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use user-facing tabs and accordions for navigation when helpful. Do not hide text or create doorway pages to manipulate ranking.

## Use this note

Inputs: Rendered page states, relevant HTML/CSS, and the user task served by any hidden or expandable content.

Result: An observed visibility/accessibility record distinguishing useful controls from suspected manipulation and identifying the next check.

## Evidence and limits

Hidden text used to manipulate ranking, doorway pages, and scaled low-value location/content pages violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: hidden-and-doorway-abuse; sources: google-search-spam-policies.)

User-facing accordions and tabs are not automatically hidden-content abuse when they serve ordinary design and user-experience purposes. (Claim: accordions-allowed; sources: google-search-spam-policies.)

wiki/content/content-homepage.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Explain the confirmed business, services, service area, and contact route clearly. Include only supported differentiators and useful next steps.

## Use this note

Inputs: Confirmed identity, services, service area, contact route, and evidence for proposed differentiators.

Result: A factual homepage Draft with a clear next step and explicit proof requests for unsupported claims.

wiki/content/content-internal-anchor-tex.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Link relevant pages using concise, descriptive anchors. Avoid quotas and forced keyword repetition.

## Use this note

Inputs: Source and target pages, their customer tasks, and the actual link markup and anchor text.

Result: A contextual internal-link proposal with descriptive anchors, resolved destinations, and no link-count target.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/content/content-outbound-authority-.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Link to evidence that helps readers evaluate a statement. A source’s reputation does not justify an irrelevant link or a promised ranking lift.

## Use this note

Inputs: The page statements requiring evidence and the exact external passages proposed as support.

Result: A statement/source/locator map and useful qualified links, rejecting irrelevant authority-name dropping.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

wiki/content/content-review-competitive-.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Compare dated, attributable facts using the same criteria for each business. State unknowns and commercial relationships; avoid invented reviews or claims of superiority.

## Use this note

Inputs: Dated attributable facts for each compared business, common comparison criteria, and commercial relationships.

Result: A fair comparison Draft showing sources, unknowns, and disclosures for human review.

wiki/content/content-service-pages.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Describe services the business actually provides, customer requirements, and the next step. Prices, outcomes, qualifications, and coverage require owner-confirmed evidence.

## Use this note

Inputs: The confirmed offering, scope and exclusions, customer requirements, and evidence for prices or qualifications.

Result: A service-page Draft with supported claims, a useful next step, and unresolved facts for owner review.

wiki/content/content-supporting-pages.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Answer a distinct customer question with relevant evidence. Link to useful related services without creating pages solely to repeat a keyword or location.

## Use this note

Inputs: The distinct customer question, relevant source passages, existing answers, and associated service pages.

Result: A useful supporting-page Draft or consolidation decision, with relevant service links and evidence gaps.

wiki/content/metadata-seo-titles-and-des.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review the existing title and description against visible page content, page purpose, and verified business facts. Draft accurate, distinctive alternatives without promising which snippet Google will display.

## Use this note

Inputs: The visible page, existing title and description, page purpose, and confirmed business facts.

Result: Title/description alternatives with their factual basis and rationale; displayed snippets remain Google-controlled.

## Evidence and limits

Google recommends clear, concise, accurate, page-specific titles and short, unique meta descriptions. Search snippets can use page content rather than the supplied description. (Claim: metadata-accurate-descriptive; sources: google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/frameworks/due-diligence-explanatio.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Confirm the evidence owner, collection method, dates, reuse rights, and privacy boundary before relying on a source. Record uncertainty and approval requirements.

## Use this note

Inputs: The source owner, collection method and date, proposed use, reuse rights, and data sensitivity.

Result: An intake decision with provenance, trust limits, privacy restrictions, missing permissions, and verification actions.

wiki/frameworks/local-link-overview.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Prioritize legitimate local relationships and useful references. Reject artificial link quotas, ratios, and paid ranking schemes.

## Use this note

Inputs: Actual local organizations, business relationships, source pages, and the purpose of each proposed reference.

Result: Relevant relationship opportunities and legitimacy checks, with owner review before outreach.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no magical ideal internal or external link count; links should be useful, contextual, crawlable, and appropriately qualified. (Claim: no-universal-link-count; sources: google-link-best-practices, google-seo-starter-guide.)

PBNs, paid ranking links without qualification, optimized forum/comment links, and link networks created primarily to manipulate ranking violate Google's spam policies. (Claim: link-schemes-prohibited; sources: google-search-spam-policies, google-link-best-practices.)

wiki/frameworks/schema-explanation.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Select vocabulary that matches visible, supported page facts, then check the relevant Google feature requirements. Record separate syntax and eligibility results.

## Use this note

Inputs: Visible page facts, existing markup, candidate Schema.org types, and the specific Google feature requirements.

Result: A fact-to-property map or Draft markup, separate syntax/eligibility results, and unsupported properties left out.

## Evidence and limits

Google Search supports JSON-LD, Microdata, and RDFa for structured data; JSON-LD is recommended for maintainability but is not the only supported format. (Claim: structured-data-formats; sources: google-structured-data-guidelines, google-structured-data-intro.)

Valid structured data creates feature eligibility and can help understanding, but Google does not guarantee rich-result appearance or document a direct organic-rank or AI-citation lift. (Claim: structured-data-no-guarantee; sources: google-structured-data-guidelines, google-localbusiness-structured-data.)

Schema.org defines vocabulary and its validator checks vocabulary/syntax; Google documentation and the Rich Results Test govern Google feature eligibility. (Claim: structured-data-vocabulary-distinction; sources: schema-localbusiness, schema-validator, google-rich-results-test.)

Self-serving reviews on an entity's own LocalBusiness or Organization pages are ineligible for Google star review features; ratings must not be aggregated from other sites. (Claim: own-business-review-markup-ineligible; sources: google-localbusiness-structured-data, google-review-snippet.)

For Google Search review-snippet eligibility, fake or undisclosed incentivized reviews are prohibited; a provided benefit must be clearly and prominently disclosed. This does not relax Maps incentive prohibitions or guarantee rich results. (Claim: review-markup-incentive-disclosure; sources: google-review-snippet, google-maps-prohibited-content.)

wiki/frameworks/the-3-phases-of-local-se.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use evidence intake, review, and approved action planning as an optional workflow. The phase names are an internal organizing aid, not a Google ranking system.

## Use this note

Inputs: The business objective, available website/profile/link evidence, and who can review proposed actions.

Result: A task sequence with evidence dependencies and approval points, adapted to the actual business rather than a mandatory phase order.

wiki/frameworks/the-core-30-content-stra.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Use the historical framework only as a reminder to inventory customer needs. Choose pages from actual useful tasks and evidence; no fixed page count is required.

## Use this note

Inputs: The actual customer needs, existing page inventory, and evidence supporting a distinct purpose for any new page.

Result: A task/page map and consolidation decisions, without a fixed page count or mandatory page mix.

## Evidence and limits

Google documents no preferred universal word count, keyword density, publication cadence, or fixed page-count framework; content should be people-first and useful for its purpose. (Claim: no-universal-content-formula; sources: google-helpful-content, google-seo-starter-guide.)

wiki/gbp/gbp-categories-edge-cases-re-th.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Review whether a category still represents the actual business. Do not re-theme a profile to chase queries or add categories for services not offered.

## Use this note

Inputs: The current categories, confirmed business operations, and the reason a category change is proposed.

Result: An accuracy review, unresolved eligibility questions, and an owner-reviewed diff or decision to retain the category.

## Evidence and limits

A Business Profile should use the real-world name and the fewest accurate categories needed to describe its core business; fixed category quotas are not official doctrine. (Claim: gbp-name-and-categories; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines, google-gbp-categories.)

wiki/gbp/gbp-categories.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Choose the most specific category describing the confirmed core business. Add categories only when accurate; record potential reverification and owner approval.

## Use this note

Inputs: The confirmed core business, current categories, and current category/representation guidance.

Result: Accurate category candidates with their business evidence, change risks, owner decision, and rollback.

## Evidence and limits

A Business Profile should use the real-world name and the fewest accurate categories needed to describe its core business; fixed category quotas are not official doctrine. (Claim: gbp-name-and-categories; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines, google-gbp-categories.)

wiki/gbp/gbp-description.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Draft a factual business description from confirmed services, identity, and service area. Have the owner check the exact text against the current representation guidelines.

## Use this note

Inputs: Owner-confirmed identity, offerings, service area, and the current description.

Result: A factual description Draft and policy check for owner review, excluding unverified differentiators.

## Evidence and limits

Business Profile information should accurately represent real operations. Descriptions, service offerings, and normal or special hours need owner-confirmed facts. (Claim: gbp-truthful-fields; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines.)

wiki/gbp/gbp-holiday-hours-maintenance-a.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Ask the owner to confirm normal and special hours using dated business records. Record the proposed profile diff and rollback; do not imply an automated-call integration.

## Use this note

Inputs: Dated owner-confirmed normal/special hours and the currently displayed hours.

Result: A proposed hours diff, confirmation record, owner approval, and rollback, without implying an automated-call integration.

## Evidence and limits

wiki/gbp/gbp-optimization.md.replacement_body:

## Evidence and limits

A service-area business that does not serve customers at its address should remove or hide that address; storefront eligibility requires a real customer-facing location. (Claim: gbp-address-service-area; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines, google-gbp-service-areas.)

(Claim: gbp-virtual-office-coworking; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines.)

## Evidence and limits

Google publicly frames local results using relevance, distance, and prominence/popularity; these are not an exhaustive public formula. (Claim: local-ranking-factors; sources: google-local-ranking.)

A service-area business that does not serve customers at its address should remove or hide that address; storefront eligibility requires a real customer-facing location. (Claim: gbp-address-service-area; sources: google-gbp-representation-guidelines, google-gbp-service-areas.)

A rented mailing or virtual-office address where the business does not operate is ineligible; a coworking storefront requires permanent signage, customer reception, and the business's own staff during stated hours. wiki/llm-seo/llm-ranking-factors.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Evaluate AI Search visibility only within a recorded platform, locale, query set, and collection window. Citation breadth and answer influence are separate observations.

## Use this note

Inputs: The platform/model, reproducible prompt or query, locale, date, responses, and collection method.

Result: Separate citation-selection and answer-influence observations, with experimental limitations and no universal factor weights.

## Evidence and limits

Generative-engine optimization experiments show bounded, domain- and platform-dependent effects; citation breadth and answer influence are distinct, so universal GEO recipes are not established. (Claim: geo-tactics-provisional; sources: geo-kdd-2024, geo-citation-absorption-2026.)

Fixed AI citation counts, Reddit citation-share percentages, and guaranteed local AIO tactics are unsupported across platforms, query classes, locales, and dates. (Claim: ai-citation-formulas-unsupported; contrary evidence: google-ai-features, geo-citation-absorption-2026.)

wiki/llm-seo/llm-schema.md.replacement_body:
## Working guidance

Google documents no additional technical requirements, mandatory special schema, or AI text file for eligibility in AI Overviews or AI Mode beyond ordinary Search requirements and policies. (Claim: ai-features-no-special-requirements; sources: google-ai-features, google-succeeding-ai-search.)

Google Search supports JSON-LD, Microdata, and RDFa for structured data; JSON-LD is recommended for maintainability but is not the only supported format. (Claim: structured-data-formats; sources: google-structured-data-guidelines, google-structured-data-intro.)
